message.content: No, it did not take more than a week for Adam to remind LiHua about the contractor team installing the air-conditioner. The timeline shows that Adam asked LiHua about the ideal installation date of the air-conditioner on July 16th at 10:00, and he reminded her about the contractor team's visit to install the air-conditioner on August 12th at 10:00. This period spans approximately two weeks, indicating that it took more than a week but not more than two weeks from Adam's initial inquiry to his final reminder about the contractor team's visit.
